knowledge_point.title: Calculating a Final Amount After Continuous Compounding Is Applied

question.:question/problem:
In the year $2014$, there were approximately $8990$ crimes in a particular city. The police department then promised a $4.7\%$ annual *decrease* in crime, continuously compounded. According to this model, how many crimes occurred in $2022$? Round your answer to the nearest integer.

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. The initial amount is $P_0=8990$. Since the amount decreases, the signed decimal rate is $r=-4.7/100=-0.047$. The elapsed time is $t=2022-2014=8$ years.

Substitute these values and round only the final amount:

$$
\begin{aligned}
P &= P_0e^{rt} \\
&= 8990e^{(-0.047)(8)} \\
&= 8990e^{-0.376} \\
&= 8990(0.6866023\ldots) \\
&\approx 6173
\end{aligned}
$$

According to this model, approximately $6173$ crimes occurred in $2022$.

question.:question/problem:
In medieval times, there were $9660$ people living in a city struck by a plague. If the disease resulted in a daily *decrease* in the population at a continuously compounded rate of $5.2\%$, what was the city's population after $3$ weeks? Round your answer to the nearest integer.

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The continuously compounded growth equation is $P=P_0e^{rt}$. The initial amount is $P_0=9660$. Since the amount decreases, the signed decimal rate is $r=-5.2/100=-0.052$. The rate is daily, so convert the duration to days: $t=3\times 7=21$ days.

Substitute these values and round only the final amount:

$$
\begin{aligned}
P &= P_0e^{rt} \\
&= 9660e^{(-0.052)(21)} \\
&= 9660e^{-1.092} \\
&= 9660(0.3355447\ldots) \\
&\approx 3241
\end{aligned}
$$

After $3$ weeks, the population was approximately $3241$ people.
